ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels occupy approximately 96% of the fluke's surface area, contrasted by high-intensity (white) pixels in a sparse punctate distribution comprising roughly 4%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A non-contiguous distribution of high-contrast white micro-dots is mapped across both lobes; no macro-scale geometric pigmentation blobs or solid bands are present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 74 degrees and a distinct pixel-depth relative to the adjacent lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge exhibits irregular, high-amplitude serrations (10-18 pixels); the left lobe exhibits a more consistent, lower-amplitude sawtooth pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves along the anterior boundaries, tapering into elongated, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely mapped spatial clusters of 1-3 pixel diameter high-intensity spots, likely corresponding to barnacle attachment points, distributed across the ventral field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, faint vertical and diagonal pixel disruptions detected in the mid-ventral region of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular notch-like tissue losses are visible along the right trailing edge, differing significantly from the left lobe's topography.
other_distinctive_markers: A characteristic 'stardust' pattern consisting of a high-density uniform field of white speckles against a uniform black pixel base.
